'''Radiation Screeners''' were produced by [[Raflkind Industrials]]. They detected the presence of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], and provided an effective screen for low-level radiation.<ref name="GFT" /> The device could protect the user from low and medium levels of radiation for up to fifty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before the [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] were depleted. High levels of radiation still remained a potential hazard. The badge would also sound an alarm and change color as radiation levels increased. They were often worn by soldiers operating in theaters where [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] was a concern.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
